question: Does extending the exact TDPn3 substrate window from ALQSSWGMMG to ALQSSWGMMGML change predicted geometry at the unchanged G7-M8 bond within RF3?
status: Two source-sequence native inputs prepared; native import, weights/runtime and inference not yet executed by this record.

source.sequence: Table S4 exact187aa TDPn3 and12mer; exact author ES model uses10mer

invariants: Same full enzyme sequence, [Zn+2].O chemical input, checkpoint and settings. No MSA, templates, catalytic-pose restraints, redesign or alternate target bond. The intended G7 C-M8 N identity is an evaluation target, not a imposed geometric constraint.

fixed_sampling.checkpoint: Pin RF3 rf3_foundry_01_24_latest_remapped.ckpt content hash before inference; use the identical file for both conditions.
fixed_sampling.output_rule: Distinct seed directories; keep every sample, score and failed/missing assignment. No rescue seeds, alternate templates, ranking-only selection or post-result parameter changes. Diffusion samples share a trunk pass; neither samples nor seeds are biological replicates.

native_import_gate: Verify exact A187/B10-or12 sequences and ordinary peptide connectivity, including G7 C-M8 N. Ligand must retain one Zn with formal charge+2 and one neutral water O; the dot-disconnected input has no Zn-O covalent bond. Save parser-created chain/atom map; identify ligand atoms by chemistry, not presumed names. Stop on ligand loss, identity drift or unsupported disconnected chemistry.

primary.metric: Distance between ligand Zn and B:Gly7 backbone O in angstrom, per assigned sample.
primary.source_contact_rule: Strictly <3.2angstrom, from fixed-target ES selection in Supplement methods paragraph198; it is a source computational filter, not a validated catalytic threshold.
primary.report: For each condition and seed: all five distances; median/range; counts contact/noncontact/missing with assigned denominator5. Report the12mer minus10mer seed-median difference. Do not substitute or pair individual diffusion indices as matched physical conformers.
primary.chemical_interpretation_gate: Zn outside the enzyme H146/H150/E45 site makes its carbonyl contact uninformative about catalytic-site recognition. Displaced water prevents a catalytic-preorganization interpretation even when Zn-carbonyl contact persists. Evaluate these using all prespecified secondary measurements, without inventing new post-result cutoffs.

essential_secondary: For every output report Zn-H146 NE2, Zn-H150 NE2, minimum Zn-E45 OE1/OE2, Zn-water O, minimum E147 OE1/OE2-water O, water O-G7 C, angle(water O,G7 C,G7 O), Y78 OH-G7 O and angle(Y78 CZ,Y78 OH,G7 O). Record each peptide amide carbonyl-to-Zn distance, especially Q3-S4, and G7 rank among them; proximity does not assign cleavage. Keep RF3 confidence in its native definitions/scale, without AF3 cutoffs. These diagnose altered metal geometry, nucleophile placement or register; no hydrogen-bond or catalytic-barrier claim follows from a distance.

decision.reproducible_loss: If each seed has >=4/5 short-window contacts and <=1/5 long-window contacts, reject portability of this short-window target contact within RF3. Diagnose local versus general metal-site disruption from the prespecified secondary metrics; neither case supports transferring the short-window pose unchanged.
decision.reproducible_gain: The reverse pattern supports window-dependent prediction and rejects treating the short window as a sufficient proxy; it does not predict higher enzyme activity.
decision.contact_retained: If both windows have >=4/5 contacts in each seed, report no large loss in this one metric, together with all secondary geometry changes. This does not establish full catalytic geometry or mechanistic invariance.
decision.otherwise: Report mixed/inconclusive or noninformative baseline performance, and stop this bounded comparison without rescue sampling. Missing outputs remain missing, not failures or imputed contacts.
decision.rule_scope: The4/5 and1/5 patterns are prespecified descriptive consistency rules for this small computational test, not calibrated probabilities, p-values or biological success rates.
decision.completeness_gate: Apply the loss/gain/retained classifications only when all four assigned condition-by-seed sets contain all five readable output structures with identified atoms. Otherwise report the incomplete comparison and observed values; missing outputs cannot satisfy <=1/5 or any other classification.

interpretation_limit: RF3 is a new predictor; the10mer is its internal reference condition, not reproduction of the author AF3 result. Adding M11/L12 also moves the modeled terminal carboxyl group, so this pair cannot separate sidechain/context effects from terminal chemistry. Both are free-peptide models, not the reporter fusion or full-length TDP43. This tests a window-transfer assumption and neither retargeting activity nor Atlas advantage.
decision_value: New predictions can falsify unchanged-window geometry transfer; further measurements of the same selected10mer cannot. The strongest feasible alternative is stopping if native chemistry or a qualified fixed runtime is unavailable, rather than treating input preparation as a computational result.
